title: TransactionEvent
description: Carried on transactions.clean. Raw DBSCAN-cleaned, trail-scoped alarm groups from the Noise Filter.

transactionId.description: Unique identifier for this transaction group.

trailId.description: Trail scope of the alarm group.

snapshotId.description: Topology snapshot in scope when this group was formed.

domain.description: the domain this snapshot/event belongs to (e.g. `core-ip`); a snapshot belongs to exactly one domain. Optional for backward-compat; consumers default to the single MVP domain when absent.

alarmIds.description: Alarm identifiers in this DBSCAN-cleaned group.

windowStart.description: Start of the raw time window (ISO-8601 UTC).

windowEnd.description: End of the raw time window (ISO-8601 UTC).
